claims.claim: **Most adolescent recreational-drug presentations involve alcohol, often with other agents.** The page covers the acute issues only.
claims.source_text: Most recreational drug related presentations for acute health intervention in Australian adolescents involve alcohol, frequently in combination with other agents. … This guideline has a limited scope, addressing the acute issues of adolescent recreational drug use.

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Amphetamines: a small dose may cause significant toxicity.** Sympathomimetic effects — agitation, sweating, tachycardia, hypertension. ⚠️ **Complications:** severe hyperthermia, rhabdomyolysis, seizures, intracranial haemorrhage, hyponatraemia, cerebral oedema.
claims.source_text: Amphetamines (small dose may produce significant toxicity) Ice, speed, gooey, whiz, base, ecstasy, love drug, MDMA, MD Central & peripheral sympathomimetic effects: - agitation, sweating, tachycardia, hypertension Medical complications: - severe hyperthermia, rhabdomyolysis, seizures, intracranial haemorrhage, hyponatraemia, cerebral oedema - 12 lead ECG - BSL - Electrolytes & renal function, CK, troponin - Consider intracranial imaging if any concern regarding vascular dissection Safe, low stimulus environment Continuous cardiac monitoring Benzodiazepines to control agitation
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Recreational drug use and overdose' (undated page), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Recreational_drug_use_and_overdose/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Investigate:** 12-lead ECG, BSL, electrolytes and renal function, CK, troponin; **consider intracranial imaging** if vascular dissection is a concern. **Manage:** safe, low-stimulus environment · **continuous cardiac monitoring** · **benzodiazepines to control agitation.**
claims.source_text: Amphetamines (small dose may produce significant toxicity) Ice, speed, gooey, whiz, base, ecstasy, love drug, MDMA, MD Central & peripheral sympathomimetic effects: - agitation, sweating, tachycardia, hypertension Medical complications: - severe hyperthermia, rhabdomyolysis, seizures, intracranial haemorrhage, hyponatraemia, cerebral oedema - 12 lead ECG - BSL - Electrolytes & renal function, CK, troponin - Consider intracranial imaging if any concern regarding vascular dissection Safe, low stimulus environment Continuous cardiac monitoring Benzodiazepines to control agitation

claims.claim: **Cannabis effects are dose related:** mild sedation, euphoria and disinhibition, progressing to CNS depression, anxiety and psychotic symptoms, postural hypotension and tachycardia.
claims.source_text: Cannabis (dose related effects) Marijuana, grass, pot, weed, ganja, dope, hashish Mild sedation, euphoria, disinhibition progressing to CNS depression, anxiety & psychotic symptoms, postural hypotension & tachycardia N/A Benign symptoms: - supportive care until asymptomatic Anxiety: - Diazepam Cardiovascular effects: - IV fluids

claims.claim: **Hallucinogens (Datura / angel's trumpet, magic mushrooms, LSD)** listed with an **anticholinergic toxidrome**: agitation, delirium, hallucinations, mydriasis, tachycardia, dry flushed skin.
claims.source_text: Hallucinogens Datura sp., Angels trumpet, magic mushrooms, LSD Central & peripheral anti-cholinergic toxidrome - agitation, delirium, hallucinations, mydriasis, tachycardia, dry flushed skin N/A Supportive care Treat delirium with titrated diazepam Anti-psychotic major tranquilisers (eg haloperidol) may worsen anti-cholinergic symptoms

claims.claim: **Supportive care; treat delirium with titrated diazepam.** ⚠️ **Antipsychotics such as haloperidol may worsen anticholinergic symptoms.**
claims.source_text: Hallucinogens Datura sp., Angels trumpet, magic mushrooms, LSD Central & peripheral anti-cholinergic toxidrome - agitation, delirium, hallucinations, mydriasis, tachycardia, dry flushed skin N/A Supportive care Treat delirium with titrated diazepam Anti-psychotic major tranquilisers (eg haloperidol) may worsen anti-cholinergic symptoms

claims.claim: **Inhalants act like alcohol** — euphoria and disinhibition, then CNS depression. ⚠️ **Complications:** sustained 'high', encephalopathy and seizures, methaemoglobinaemia, **cardiac arrhythmia and sudden death.**
claims.source_text: Inhalants/Volatile Substance Abuse Huffing, bagging, sniffing, chroming Similar effects to alcohol intoxication: - initial euphoria & disinhibition followed by CNS depression Acute medical complications: - sustained 'high', encephalopathy & seizures, methaemoglobinaemia, cardiac arrhythmia & sudden death Treat behavioural disturbance/delirium with diazepam Cardiac arrest resuscitation should limit the use of exogenous adrenaline
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Recreational drug use and overdose' (undated page), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Recreational_drug_use_and_overdose/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Treat behavioural disturbance or delirium with diazepam.** ⚠️ **In cardiac arrest, limit exogenous adrenaline.**
claims.source_text: Inhalants/Volatile Substance Abuse Huffing, bagging, sniffing, chroming Similar effects to alcohol intoxication: - initial euphoria & disinhibition followed by CNS depression Acute medical complications: - sustained 'high', encephalopathy & seizures, methaemoglobinaemia, cardiac arrhythmia & sudden death Treat behavioural disturbance/delirium with diazepam Cardiac arrest resuscitation should limit the use of exogenous adrenaline

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Opioids: CNS and respiratory depression with miosis.** Dextropropoxyphene — seizures and arrhythmias; **tramadol — seizures and serotonin syndrome.**
claims.source_text: Opiates CNS & respiratory depression associated with miosis Dextropropoxyphene (Digesic) - seizures & arrhythmias Tramadol - seizures & serotonin syndrome Monitor for CNS & respiratory depression Airway protection & ventilation ensures good outcome Naloxone infusion (note short half life) Treat seizures with benzodiazepines and phenobarbitone
